Technical SEO.title: Google's Indexing API Docs No Longer Explain How To Get Approval
Technical SEO.summary: Google removed the Indexing API approval form and steps from its documentation. Default quotas are still listed, but the pages no longer explain how to request additional quota.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Rank Tracker Data, ChatGPT Tags and AI Search Links - SEO Pulse
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A rank tracker logged Google pages missing their usual sites, some ChatGPT links lost tracking tags, and both Google and Bing made changes to their AI search links. The roundup covers multiple concurrent shifts affecting SEO measurement tooling.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google updates AI Mode and AI Overview with more links, context, carousels, and information on creators
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has updated both AI Mode and AI Overviews to surface more prominent inline links, additional context, carousels, and creator information. These changes directly affect how source sites appear and are credited within AI-generated answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google pushes links higher in AI answers as Preferred Sources use rises 7x
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is repositioning links higher within AI-generated answers while the Preferred Sources feature has seen a sevenfold rise in usage. This signals a meaningful structural shift in how citations and source authority are weighted inside AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: OpenAI's API Only Partly Matched ChatGPT's Citations, Paper Finds
AI Search / GEO.summary: A research paper tested whether Google results and the OpenAI API can serve as reliable proxies for ChatGPT's citation behavior, finding they matched cited sites more often than they matched the exact cited pages. The discrepancy has implications for GEO research methodology that relies on API-based citation tracking.

AI Search / GEO.title: Life After SEO: How Newsrooms Are Adapting to the AI Search Shift
AI Search / GEO.summary: The Reuters Institute examines how newsrooms are rethinking content and distribution strategies in response to the shift toward AI-driven search. The piece offers a publisher-side perspective relevant to enterprise content teams navigating reduced traditional organic traffic.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media analyzed over 13,000 citations generated across four AI tools to identify patterns in how LLMs select sources to reference. The dataset provides empirical grounding for GEO strategy decisions around content authority and domain positioning.

AI Search / GEO.title: Position: Generative Engine Optimization Creates Underexamined Risks, Governance Must Target Concentration, Disclosure, and Academic Blind Spots
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic paper argues that GEO practices introduce underexamined risks around source concentration and disclosure, and calls for governance frameworks targeting these blind spots. Enterprise SEO teams investing in GEO should be aware of the emerging regulatory and ethical scrutiny the discipline is attracting.
